transport.name: CAN bus
transport.desc: Subaru UDS RAM logging over ISO 15765 (CAN), 500 kbit/s (needs a RomRaider build with the SUBUDS protocol)

module.desc: Engine Control Unit, RH850 (2022+ WRX, 2023+ Ascent and Legacy / Outback XT): UDS on 0x7A2

ecuparam.name: Engine Speed
ecuparam.desc: Engine Speed (read; 0x11EE38: FFF8CD54 x 25 >> 5 (u16) = rpm x 4)

ecuparam.name: Coolant Temperature
ecuparam.desc: Coolant Temperature (read; 0x11F250: FFF8CD65 (degC + 50) - 10, floored at 0)

ecuparam.name: Intake Air Temperature
ecuparam.desc: Intake Air Temperature (read; 0x11F098: FFF8CEE5 (the OBD IAT source, degC + 50) - 10, floored at 0)

ecuparam.name: Ignition Timing
ecuparam.desc: Ignition Timing (read; 0x11E728: final timing FFF8A744 + 128 (0.5 degree units))

ecuparam.name: Mass Airflow
ecuparam.desc: Mass Airflow (read; 0x11EF60: FFF88A4A x 0x753 >> 12, the same conversion as OBD PID 0x10 (0.01 g/s))

ecuparam.name: MAF Sensor Voltage
ecuparam.desc: MAF Sensor Voltage (inferred; 0x11F28C: FFF88A1A x 125 >> 15; volts if FFF88A1A = V x 13107)

ecuparam.name: Manifold Absolute Pressure
ecuparam.desc: Manifold Absolute Pressure (inferred; 0x11EEDC: FFF88A34 >> 8; kPa because index 0x24 is this minus barometric pressure + 128)

ecuparam.name: Manifold Relative Pressure
ecuparam.desc: Manifold Relative Pressure (read; 0x11E7FC: (FFF88A34 >> 8) - (FFF88E1E >> 8) + 128, clipped to 0...255; FFF88E1E is the OBD barometric source)

ecuparam.name: Barometric Pressure
ecuparam.desc: Barometric Pressure (read; 0x11E75C: FFF88668 (kPa x 256) >> 8)

ecuparam.name: Wastegate Duty
ecuparam.desc: Wastegate Duty (read; 0x11E910: FFF8B3B8 (WGDC, 25600 = 100 %) x 255/25600)

ecuparam.name: Commanded Throttle
ecuparam.desc: Commanded Throttle (read; 0x11F218: FFF8AF84 x 255/25600; FFF8AF84 is the OBD PID 0x4C (commanded throttle actuator) source, written by 0x0C326C in the torque model)

ecuparam.name: Battery Voltage
ecuparam.desc: Battery Voltage (inferred; 0x11F29C: FFF9DD61 x 125 >> 7; FFF9DD61 = V x 12.8 (inferred))

ecuparam.name: Vehicle Speed
ecuparam.desc: Vehicle Speed (inferred; 0x11F2B0: FFF99835 copied; the programming-session check 0x0AF014 refuses while FFF99835 > cal 0x579AA, i.e. a vehicle-speed check (inferred))

ecuparam.name: Knock Learning (DAM)
ecuparam.desc: Knock Learning (DAM) (inferred; FFF811AE pointed to directly; DAM x 16 (inferred, see Knock Correction Advance))

ecuparam.name: Throttle Position
ecuparam.desc: Throttle Position (read; 0x11E708: FFF8A346 (the OBD PID 0x11 source, 65535 = 100 %) x 125 >> 15 = % x 2.5)

ecuparam.name: FFF8A348 (Throttle Scale)
ecuparam.desc: FFF8A348 (Throttle Scale) (inferred; 0x11E718: FFF8A348 x 125 >> 15, same scale as Throttle Position; likely the second throttle signal (inferred))

ecuparam.name: FFF8A350 (Throttle Scale)
ecuparam.desc: FFF8A350 (Throttle Scale) (inferred; 0x11EF70: FFF8A350 x 125 >> 15; identity not decoded (pedal or throttle signal))

ecuparam.name: FFF8A352 (Throttle Scale)
ecuparam.desc: FFF8A352 (Throttle Scale) (inferred; 0x11EF80: FFF8A352 x 125 >> 15; identity not decoded)

ecuparam.name: Closed Loop Lambda (FFF8B2C2)
ecuparam.desc: Closed Loop Lambda (FFF8B2C2) (read; 0x11EDA4: (FFF8B2C2 << 15) / cal 0x38278 (43194 = lambda 1.0) - 32768, >> 8, + 128; written by the closed-loop routines 0x0FBAFC/0x0FC0CC, role (measured or target) not decoded)

ecuparam.name: Closed Loop Target (FFF8B312)
ecuparam.desc: Closed Loop Target (FFF8B312) (read; 0x11ED68: ((FFF8B312 >> 1) - 0x5587) x 0x3BDD >> 18 + 64, clipped; FFF8B312 is the closed-loop target in lambda x 43194 units (0x0FF634); the byte covers only lambda 0.96...1.17)

ecuparam.name: FFF8B2D8 (Fuel Correction)
ecuparam.desc: FFF8B2D8 (Fuel Correction) (inferred; 0x11ED58: FFF8B2D8 >> 8; FFF8B2D8 = 0x8000 when not running (0x0FBF58), so 128 = no correction (inferred))

ecuparam.name: Knock Raw (A791/A7A7)
ecuparam.desc: Knock Raw (A791/A7A7) (read; 0x11F1E4: (FFF8A791 x 19 + FFF8A7A7 (s8) x 19 + 0xD80) / 27; knock-module variables, meaning not decoded)

ecuparam.name: FFF8A7A7 (Knock Module)
ecuparam.desc: FFF8A7A7 (Knock Module) (read; 0x11EF08: FFF8A7A7 (s8) x 45 >> 6 + 90)

ecuparam.name: AVCS FFF8B8EA
ecuparam.desc: AVCS FFF8B8EA (read; 0x11EE88: FFF8B8EA x 0xD0E5 >> 19; AVCS module variable (read by the OCV driver 0x15969C))

ecuparam.name: AVCS FFF8B8E4
ecuparam.desc: AVCS FFF8B8E4 (read; 0x11EE68: FFF8B8E4 x 0xD0E5 >> 19; AVCS module variable)

ecuparam.name: AVCS FFF8B900
ecuparam.desc: AVCS FFF8B900 (read; 0x11E990: FFF8B900 x 0xD0E5 >> 19; AVCS module variable)

ecuparam.name: AVCS FFF8B8FA
ecuparam.desc: AVCS FFF8B8FA (read; 0x11E970: FFF8B8FA x 0xD0E5 >> 19; AVCS module variable)

ecuparam.name: Long-Term Fuel Trim (FFF811D9)
ecuparam.desc: Long-Term Fuel Trim (FFF811D9) (read; SSM byte = FFF811D9 >> 1 + 64 (0x11EC9C, read). FFF811D9 = learned cell + 0x80 (0x0FD3E4) is copied to FFF8A689 (0x0CECA8), and fuel is multiplied by (A689 + 128)/256 (0x0D15EC, read), so one count of 811D9 = 0.39 %; on the SSM byte, % = (x-128) x 100/128 (corrected 2026-10-30; it was shown double).)

ecuparam.name: Intake Cam Advance Bank 1 (FFF88DB0)
ecuparam.desc: Intake Cam Advance Bank 1 (FFF88DB0) (inferred; learned rest FFF81582 - measured FFF88D8C, advance positive; cam edges later = larger (0x1D165A) (read, my research notes).)

ecuparam.name: Intake Cam Advance Bank 2 (FFF88DB2)
ecuparam.desc: Intake Cam Advance Bank 2 (FFF88DB2) (inferred; learned rest FFF81582 - measured FFF88D8C, advance positive; cam edges later = larger (0x1D165A) (read, my research notes).)

ecuparam.name: Exhaust Cam Retard Bank 1 (FFF88DBC)
ecuparam.desc: Exhaust Cam Retard Bank 1 (FFF88DBC) (inferred; measured FFF88DA0 - learned rest FFF8157E, retard positive; cam edges later = larger (0x1D165A) (read, my research notes).)

ecuparam.name: Exhaust Cam Retard Bank 2 (FFF88DBE)
ecuparam.desc: Exhaust Cam Retard Bank 2 (FFF88DBE) (inferred; measured FFF88DA0 - learned rest FFF8157E, retard positive; cam edges later = larger (0x1D165A) (read, my research notes).)

ecuparam.name: Accelerator Pedal
ecuparam.desc: Accelerator Pedal (read; Index 0x029 points directly at FFF88A5E (2015/2016; FFF88DAE 2017, FFF88E3E 2018), the high byte of the u16 pedal value (65535 = 100 %) that feeds the Requested Torque maps (0x09E800 / 0x0BB588, read))

ecuparam.name: ETC Motor Drive
ecuparam.desc: ETC Motor Drive (inferred; Shadow FFF8A93A from FFF8A3B4 (x - 128, read); FFF8A3B4 is the electronic throttle motor drive of the servo loop (inferred, Phase 13))

ecuparam.name: A/F Sensor Lambda
ecuparam.desc: A/F Sensor Lambda (read; 0x11F040: FFF88AF8 >> 6, capped at 255; FFF88AF8 = measured lambda x 8192 from the front A/F sensor (0x06C1A8, read), the same variable OBD PIDs 0x24/0x34 report. Reads up to lambda 1.99; AFR assumes 14.7 stoich)

ecuparam.name: Calculated Engine Load (OBD)
ecuparam.desc: Calculated Engine Load (OBD) (read; 0x11EDE4 copies FFF886A2, which is also the OBD PID 0x04 source (0x171AC4 -> FFF8AB77, read); 255 = 100 %)

ecuparam.name: Injector Pulse Width (Injector 1)
ecuparam.desc: Injector Pulse Width (Injector 1) (inferred; 0x11F1C0: FFF8CF3C x 0x3333 >> 20 (= /80), capped at 255; FFF8CF3C = injector 1 pulse u32 >> 2 (0x1E5436, read). The pulse unit of 0.8 us is inferred (as logging-patch L24), so 0.256 ms per count; it saturates at about 65 ms)

ecuparam.name: Radiator Fan Duty
ecuparam.desc: Radiator Fan Duty (read; 0x11EFE0: FFF8B278 x 25 >> 14; FFF8B278 = radiator fan duty, 65535 = 100 % (0x0F7A88, read))

ecuparam.name: Purge Valve Duty
ecuparam.desc: Purge Valve Duty (read; 0x11E85C: FFF8A707 x 65 >> 6, the same conversion and source as OBD PID 0x2E, commanded evaporative purge (0x1715D0 -> FFF8AB6A, read))

ecuparam.name: Alternator Duty
ecuparam.desc: Alternator Duty (inferred; 0x11E88C: FFF8B718 x 0x7AE1 >> 19 (x 0.06); FFF8B718 = charging output command, 1667 = 100 % (read; alternator identity inferred))

ecuparam.name: EGR Valve Position
ecuparam.desc: EGR Valve Position (inferred; 0x11E9B0: FFF88A1C >> 1, capped at 255; FFF88A1C is the EGR valve position feedback, compared with 2 x the EGR command FFF8A81B for OBD PID 0x2D (0x1715F0, read); the step unit is inferred)

ecuparam.name: Intake OCV Current (Cam 1)
ecuparam.desc: Intake OCV Current (Cam 1) (inferred; 0x11EEB8: FFF88D70 x 625 >> 19; FFF88D70 x 2.5/65536 is the measured OCV current of the intake cam 1 AVCS current feedback (0x15ED58, read); amps inferred)

ecuparam.name: Intake OCV Current (Cam 2)
ecuparam.desc: Intake OCV Current (Cam 2) (inferred; 0x11EEA8: FFF88D72 x 625 >> 19; measured OCV current of intake cam 2 (0x15F158, read); amps inferred)

ecuparam.name: Exhaust OCV Current (Cam 1)
ecuparam.desc: Exhaust OCV Current (Cam 1) (inferred; 0x11EB18: FFF88D84 x 625 >> 19; measured OCV current of exhaust cam 1 (0x163394, read); amps inferred)

ecuparam.name: Exhaust OCV Current (Cam 2)
ecuparam.desc: Exhaust OCV Current (Cam 2) (inferred; 0x11EB08: FFF88D86 x 625 >> 19; measured OCV current of exhaust cam 2 (0x163788, read); amps inferred)

ecuparam.name: Brake Booster Pressure
ecuparam.desc: Brake Booster Pressure (inferred; 0x11EEE8: FFF88D10 >> 8; FFF88D10 = filtered analog pressure input in kPa x 256, compared with barometric pressure FFF88668 (0x06CF60, read); the brake-booster vacuum model uses baro minus this (identity inferred))

ecuparam.name: Target Torque
ecuparam.desc: Target Torque (read; FFF8AECA: target torque after the max-torque caps and shaping (0x0BD404 via 0x0BA868); axis of Target Boost and Wastegate Duty Initial/Maximum. Nm = x/80 - 200 (0x116A0C float constants). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Target Torque (read; Ascent: FFF8C762 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Throttle Torque Request
ecuparam.desc: Throttle Torque Request (read; FFF8AEDA: throttle-side torque request after the rev/boost torque limits (0x0BD62C), input of the throttle model 0x0C3E34 (AF98 = AF62 + AEDA - 16000). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Throttle Torque Request (read; Ascent: FFF8C772 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Base Timing
ecuparam.desc: Base Timing (read; FFF8A645 (s8, MOV.B): selected Base Timing table, rate-limited, plus two corrections (0x0C2C08); 0.5 degree units. Feeds A76A -> A76D -> A74B -> fired timing FFF8A744. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Base Timing (read; Ascent: FFF8BD78 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Feedback Knock Correction
ecuparam.desc: Feedback Knock Correction (read; FFF8A79A (s8 <= 0): FBKC integrator (0x0E2BE4); 0x0D9E40 adds x*180>>8 to the 0.5 degree timing sum, so one count = 0.3516 degree. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Feedback Knock Correction (read; Ascent: FFF8BF03 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Fine Learning Knock Correction
ecuparam.desc: Fine Learning Knock Correction (read; FFF8A7A7 (s8): applied FLKC cell value (0x0E73CC), same 0.3516 degree count as FBKC (0x0D9088: x 0x5A / 128). Index 0x199 (J23) carries a coarser copy (x*45>>6 + 90). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Fine Learning Knock Correction (read; Ascent: FFF8BF19 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Knock Correction Advance
ecuparam.desc: Knock Correction Advance (read; FFF8A791 (u8, MOVU.B): KCA = KCA max x DAM curve (0x0E1FD8); same count as FBKC (0x0DB3D4 x 180 >> 8). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Knock Correction Advance (read; Ascent: FFF8BEF6 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Total Knock Correction
ecuparam.desc: Total Knock Correction (read; FFF8A77B (s8) = clamp(FBKC A79A + KCA A791 + FLKC A7A7, -128..127), 0 while FFF886AB bit 5 (0x0DFA88). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Total Knock Correction (read; Ascent: FFF8BEDD on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Combustion Mode
ecuparam.desc: Combustion Mode (read; FFF8A85C (u8): 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 after start (0x109B4C); 2 = stratified catalyst heating, 3 = second phase, 4 = normal running (roles inferred, Phase 7 / my research notes). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Combustion Mode (read; Ascent: FFF8BFD8 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Fuel Rail Pressure
ecuparam.desc: Fuel Rail Pressure (read; FFF88884 (u16): filtered rail pressure used by the HPFP controller (0x164DB0 actual vs target) and OBD PID 0x23 (2015/2016); 1639.34 counts per MPa (injector-table axes). In 2017/2018 PID 0x23 reads a different variable; the value here is the HPFP controller input in every image. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Fuel Rail Pressure (read; Ascent: FFF89768 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Target Fuel Rail Pressure
ecuparam.desc: Target Fuel Rail Pressure (read; FFF8B9A0 (u16): HPFP target (0x165180: table byte x 150), same unit as the actual. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Target Fuel Rail Pressure (read; Ascent: FFF8D48E on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Target Boost
ecuparam.desc: Target Boost (read; FFF8B3B0 (u16): compensated boost target (0x108678: Target Boost(rpm, target torque) x baro/IAT comp), boost-control unit kPa abs = (x + 3404)/256; psi shown against 101.325 kPa (project convention). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Target Boost (read; FFF8ACC4 (u16): final boost target of the electronic-wastegate control (Target Boost (Electronic Wastegate) x the IAT and rpm/baro multipliers, capped; 0x0C8B4A). Same unit as the measured pressure: kPa abs = (x + 3404)/256 (0x232C9A). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Boost Control Pressure
ecuparam.desc: Boost Control Pressure (read; FFF89264 (u16): the boost controller's measured manifold pressure (0x1080E4 error = B3B0 - 89264), same unit as Target Boost. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Boost Control Pressure (read; FFF8A14A (u16): measured manifold pressure the boost control compares with its target (0x0C90B2), from FFF8A008 = MAP - 3404 (0x232C9A). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Wastegate Duty (Full Resolution)
ecuparam.desc: Wastegate Duty (Full Resolution) (read; FFF8B3B8 (u16): wastegate duty to timer E channel 11 (0x1088B4), 25600 = 100 %. J10 is the same value / 100.4. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Wastegate Duty Feedback
ecuparam.desc: Wastegate Duty Feedback (inferred; FFF8B3AA (s16): boost feedback P + I (0x1080E4), added to the initial duty in 0x108098 (B3A8 = min(B38C x B3B6/32768 + B3AA, B39C)); duty unit 256 per % assumed from B3B8 (inferred). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Closed Loop Target
ecuparam.desc: Closed Loop Target (read; FFF8B31E (u16): closed-loop target, equivalence ratio x 32768 (0x0FF8C8; OBD helper 0x171C88 reports 2^30/x). AFR uses stoich 14.7 (assumed). J20 is a coarse byte of the earlier stage B312. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Closed Loop Target (read; Ascent: FFF8CC44 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: A/F Correction (Closed Loop)
ecuparam.desc: A/F Correction (Closed Loop) (read; FFF8B2F4 (s16): closed-loop correction (0x0FEC3C), factor B2EA = 32768 + B2F4 (0x0FE7F0), limited to +-11469; 32768 = 100 % (inferred from the factor form). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: A/F Correction (Closed Loop) (read; Ascent: FFF8CC10 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning (FFF811D6)
ecuparam.desc: A/F Learning (FFF811D6) (inferred; FFF811D6 (s8, backup RAM): high byte of the learned value FFF8B2E0 (0x0FC400 -> 0x0FC5B4); feeds the long-term trim chain 0x0FD3E4 -> FFF811D9 -> FFF8A689. one count = 0.39 % (the trim chain multiplies fuel by (A689+128)/256, 0x0D15EC, read; corrected 2026-10-30 from 0.78 %). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: A/F Learning (FFF811D6) (inferred; Ascent: FFF81049 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Throttle Model Air Requirement
ecuparam.desc: Throttle Model Air Requirement (inferred; FFF8AFA8 (u16): (AF2C - 16000)/(AF64 - 16000) x min(05A118, AF56) x 4 (0x0C37D8), 32768 = 1.0; input of Throttle Required Area 05A148 (meaning as % of full-load air inferred). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Throttle Model Air Requirement (inferred; Ascent: FFF8C852 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Torque Model Throttle Opening
ecuparam.desc: Torque Model Throttle Opening (inferred; FFF8AF12 (u16): throttle opening from the Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables (0x0C0010), rate-limited; 65535 = 100 % (inferred from being the input of 059D2C). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Torque Model Throttle Opening (inferred; Ascent: FFF8C7B6 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Throttle Required Area
ecuparam.desc: Throttle Required Area (read; FFF8AFB4 (u16): Throttle Required Area 05A148(rpm, AFA8) (0x0C4D84), input of Throttle Opening 05A0BC in 0x0C326C; 21468 = wide open (physical unit not determined). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Throttle Required Area (read; Ascent: FFF8C85E on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: ETC Target
ecuparam.desc: ETC Target (read; FFF8AFBA (u16): ETC target after start add, idle floor and fault caps (0x0C4E5C); % = (x - 10)/460.09. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: ETC Target (read; Ascent: FFF8C864 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Intake Cam Target
ecuparam.desc: Intake Cam Target (inferred; FFF8B94A (s16): final intake AVCS target of 0x15C250 (clamped +-90 degrees, 364.09 counts per degree), read by 0x15C880. Units read; crank/cam degrees and sign convention not verified (inferred). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Intake Cam Target (inferred; Ascent: FFF8D436 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Exhaust Cam Target
ecuparam.desc: Exhaust Cam Target (inferred; FFF8B90A (s16): final exhaust AVCS target of 0x16032C, read by 0x1608D8. Same unit and caveat as intake. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Exhaust Cam Target (inferred; Ascent: FFF8D3E8 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Injector Pulse Width (C0B0)
ecuparam.desc: Injector Pulse Width (C0B0) (inferred; Low word of FFF8C0B0 (u32): output of the first pulse routine 0x0D2BB8 (latency + quantity x flow comp, x 1.25 = counts of 0.8 us). Logged as the low 16 bits: wraps above 52.4 ms. First injector / first pulse (inferred from the call order). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.) Ascent: Injector Pulse Width (C0B0) (inferred; Ascent: FFF8DBA6 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity.)

ecuparam.name: Wastegate Motor Duty
ecuparam.desc: Wastegate Motor Duty (read; FFF8A96C (s16): wastegate motor drive (0x0C9B64); positive opens, negative closes. The output stage sets the H-bridge PWM to period x |duty| / 25600 (0x22A2EC), so 25600 = 100 %. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Wastegate Position
ecuparam.desc: Wastegate Position (read; FFF8A960 (u16): wastegate position from its sensor (0x085778); 16384 = closed on the seat, larger = more open. % open taking 32768 as fully open (inferred). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Wastegate Position Command
ecuparam.desc: Wastegate Position Command (read; FFF8AC98 (u16): the position the wastegate motor loop follows (0x0C9520), same unit as Wastegate Position. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Boost Error
ecuparam.desc: Boost Error (read; FFF8ACD2 (s16): boost target minus measured pressure (0x0C90B2); positive = below target. P0234 and P0299 count on it. Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Target Boost (Table)
ecuparam.desc: Target Boost (Table) (read; FFF8ACCC (u16): Target Boost (Electronic Wastegate) table output, by rpm and target torque, before the multipliers and cap (0x0C8B32). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Wastegate Control Mode
ecuparam.desc: Wastegate Control Mode (read; FFF8ACB3 (u8): 0 open (low rpm), 1 feed-forward only, 2 closed loop, 3 closed, 4 engine not running (inferred), 5 fixed position, 6 sweep (0x0C8998). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Wastegate Position Sensor Voltage
ecuparam.desc: Wastegate Position Sensor Voltage (read; FFF8A95E (u16): wastegate position sensor input, 65535 = 5 V (fault limits 0.46 V / 4.68 V, P2564 / P2565). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Wastegate Position Feed-Forward
ecuparam.desc: Wastegate Position Feed-Forward (read; FFF8ACCE (u16): feed-forward position from Wastegate Position Feed-Forward (rpm x boost target), before the boost PI (0x0C8C18). Read straight from RAM: no logging patch needed with SUBUDS.)

ecuparam.name: Mass Airflow Sensor Voltage
ecuparam.desc: Mass Airflow Sensor Voltage: the ECU's own mode-22 value (DID 10A1), read from its RAM copy; 35 of 35 ECUs

ecuparam.name: Accelerator Pedal Angle
ecuparam.desc: Accelerator Pedal Angle: the ECU's own mode-22 value (DID 10A6), read from its RAM copy; 35 of 35 ECUs
